description: Implement leave data layer with domain models (LeaveType, LeaveStatus, LeaveBalance, LeaveRequest) and LeaveRepository with mock data for all leave operations including balance checks, request submission, and approval workflows
steps: Create lib/features/leaves/domain/leave_models.dart with enums LeaveType (annual, sick, casual, maternity, paternity, unpaid) and LeaveStatus (pending, approved, rejected, cancelled)
Define LeaveBalance model with annual/sick/casual properties, each having total/used/remaining fields
Define LeaveRequest model with id, employeeId, employeeName, leaveType, startDate, endDate, daysRequested, reason, status, appliedAt, reviewedBy, reviewedAt, reviewNotes, overlappingColleagues fields
Implement getLeaveBalance(employeeId) method returning Future<LeaveBalance> with realistic mock data
Implement getLeaveRequests(employeeId) method returning Future<List<LeaveRequest>> with employee's leave history
Implement submitLeaveRequest(request) method with validation and mock submission logic
Implement getPendingApprovals() method for managers returning Future<List<LeaveRequest>>
Implement approveLeave(requestId, reviewerId, notes) and rejectLeave(requestId, reviewerId, notes) methods
acceptance_criteria: All domain models compile without errors and include proper copyWith/toJson/fromJson methods
LeaveRepository provides realistic mock data with proper date ranges and status transitions
Balance checks correctly calculate remaining days based on used days
Repository methods handle edge cases like invalid employee IDs gracefully
verification: Run `flutter analyze lib/features/leaves/domain/` and verify no compilation errors
Run `flutter analyze lib/features/leaves/data/` and verify repository compiles successfully
Create simple test script to verify repository methods return expected data structures
